provider_dependencies.reason: Basic exclusively owns physical feedback, group leases, motor modes, fencing, and caps.
Contact owns arm POSITION_EFFORT_LIMITED motion and arm holding while carrying.

limitations: Software-tested development implementation; the owner-requested torque-only 0.15 Nm contact threshold, 85 C admission gate, and effector vectors require physical qualification
torque_limit_nm is a motor torque ceiling, not a calibrated jaw force
object presence is inferred from absolute measured gripper motor torque and must be bound explicitly before carrying
a hot joint during carrying produces a release recommendation but never silently drops the object
